anthropic.use: launch announcements and API model ids for the Claude models
anthropic.terms: Public vendor pages, read as published on checked_at.

anthropic_release_notes.use: dated launch entries; the day of a release when the announcement page gives only a month
anthropic_release_notes.terms: Public vendor documentation, read as published on checked_at.

openai.use: dated release entries and API model ids for the GPT models
openai.terms: Public vendor documentation, read as published on checked_at.

google.use: dated release entries and API model ids for the Gemini models
google.terms: Public vendor documentation, read as published on checked_at.

basis.rows: Every row is a model line in the D91 sense: one tier of one vendor, at its current version. The slug carries no version number. Older versions of a tier are not seeded separately.
basis.tiers: Tiers such as Haiku, Fable, Astra, Luna, Sol, Terra, Argon and Flash are separate lines, not successive versions. Lite and nano tiers and models in restricted access are excluded. Muse Wonder is excluded until the owner rules on its source (#329).
basis.description: One neutral sentence naming the vendor and the current version (#329). Vendor marketing copy stays out, because description text feeds a scoring keyword bonus. The vendor's own wording stays in each row's proof note.
basis.modality: text for every row; image and video models are out of scope (D52).
basis.release_date: The date the vendor page names for the release of the current version. Each row's proof note quotes it.
basis.price: Left null for every row. Vendor price tables are banded or were not confirmed on checked_at; a price is added by a later reviewed change.
basis.status: Rows are inactive. Activation is a separate owner decision after the rows are loaded.
basis.open_weight: false for every row; these are closed models.
basis.scope: This file is a reviewed seed only. Nothing here is read by ranking or scoring code.
